The ruling's limit is the eye-to-chin height, eye z 1.840 to chin z 1.715 = 12.5 cm, so the bill is under it. At HEAD, base, Highrim and Almanac are identical: peak 14.4 cm at y 1.81, and 11.6-12.7 cm from y 1.78 down to 1.70, which is under the scarf's 17.1 cm at y 1.66. The bill is a small round nub under the brow and the mask reads as a carved gold mask, not a plague-doctor beak. `python3 art/blender/common/facechip.py gate`: 120 pairs, min 59.1 (dunsom-ulkro), median 70.6, 0 under 55 (_harness/_reports/integ_chars_ver1_facechip_gate.txt). art/renders/lineup/integ_chars_dunsom.json: silhouetteOk, 153 pairs, 0 not ok, max IoU64 0.739 (burdam-hesmi). _design/fighters/dunsom.md:31 and :55 record the bill. Watch only, not a failure: the mask keeps hollow ink eye recesses and a cracked-tile relief. At portrait size it reads stern, not horror. If it is ever revisited, warm eye inlays in the style of ruling 2 would be the standard fix.

The per-fighter budget is met. All 48 GLBs hold 16,340-23,579 triangles (CONTRACT _spec/CONTRACT.md:850 says 10-25k) and at most 1,193,332 bytes (_harness/_reports/integ_chars_ver1_glb_tris.txt). The LOD1 recipe re-runs as claimed: `node art/blender/fighters/_lod1.mjs --json` gives 48 GLBs, body 955,762 -> 580,849 (0.608), worst 10 mm, head-locked 152,516 of 152,516 kept (_harness/_reports/integ_chars_ver1_lod1.json). The base average is 19,653 -> 11,916 and the largest LOD1 body is 15,118 (hesmi_gorgewalk). I viewed the A/B close sheets: faces identical, and the LOD1 robe shows faint faceting only in the close 3/4 view. The done criterion is NOT met. No perf_1080 --prod was run, and the renderer does not draw the LOD1: src/render/lod.ts:96 has `lodSwitch = { shadow: true, outline: false }`, actors.ts:979 builds the outline from the full part.geometry, and grep finds no simplifyWithAttributes or head lock in src/render. The newest prod sweep is _harness/_reports/integ_engine_v1_perf_1080.json (build prod, 2026-10-29 00:29 local). Its misses: 'peak triangles 1031094 > 500000 at 1264.5 s' and 'peak programs 41 > 40'. At the peak, actors:fighter is 403,711 (main 367,278 over 34 calls, shadow 36,433), actors:crowd 334,321 and actors:structure 80,761. The lane's evidence still quotes 857,978 / ~734k from the older fw_W1_perf_1080_polish2.json. Re-estimated on the new peak: LOD1 at ~0.61 on the fighters' main body and hull cuts ~140k, which leaves the peak near ~890k, still far over 500k. The dequantization in the handoff is per fighter, 0.82 (sukri) to 1.24 (ardit) m per unit, not a constant ~1.2.
